hero.description: Accept ZainCash, AsiaHawala, and Cards with a single API. Built for developers, trusted by banks.
footer.cta.description: Join 500+ businesses using Rasedi to process payments, automate payouts, and scale faster.
footer.brand.description: The financial operating system for modern Iraqi commerce. Unified payments, simplified.
journey.description: From zero to revenue in four simple steps.
journey.step.1.title: 1. Create Merchant Account
journey.step.1.desc: Sign up in seconds. No paperwork required for initial access. Just your email and phone number.
journey.step.2.title: 2. Get KYC Verified
journey.step.2.desc: Automated identity verification. Upload your ID and business registration. Approved in under 24 hours.
journey.step.3.title: 3. Create Payment Link
journey.step.3.desc: Generate a secure link from your dashboard. Set amount, currency, and description. No coding needed.
journey.step.4.title: 4. Get Paid
journey.step.4.desc: Funds settle instantly to your Rasedi wallet. Withdraw to your bank or ZainCash anytime.
dev.description: Forget complex SOAP integrations and PDF documentation. Rasedi provides a modern, typesafe REST API that you can integrate in minutes, not months.
company.description: Rasedi is not just a payment gateway. We are an operating system for the modern Iraqi economy. Our mission is to bridge the gap between local cash traditions and the global digital economy.
company.dna.title: Our DNA
company.dna.description: We combine Silicon Valley engineering standards with deep local market expertise. We understand that Baghdad is not Berlin, and we build specifically for our context.
company.promise.title: Our Promise
company.promise.description: Reliability above all. When money is moving, "works most of the time" is not enough. We aim for 99.99% uptime and instant settlement.
company.contact.title: Contact Us
company.contact.subtitle: Enterprises and partners, let's talk.
developers.hero.description: A developer-first financial platform. strictly typed SDKs, predictable REST endpoints, and Iraq's most reliable sandbox environment.
developers.flow.title: Integration Flow
developers.flow.step1.title: Get Credentials
developers.flow.step1.desc: Create a merchant account and generate your `rk_live` and `rk_test` API keys from the dashboard.
developers.flow.step2.title: Install SDK
developers.flow.step2.desc: Add our official library to your project. We support Node, PHP, .NET, Python, and Go.
developers.flow.step3.title: Go Live
developers.flow.step3.desc: Switch your key from `rk_test` to `rk_live` and start processing real IQD payments instantly.
developers.capabilities.title: Everything you need
developers.capabilities.description: Full-stack financial tools for the modern internet economy.
developers.cap.webhooks.title: Real-time Webhooks
developers.cap.webhooks.desc: Listen for `payment.succeeded` events to fulfill orders instantly without polling.
developers.cap.vault.title: Tokenization (Vault)
developers.cap.vault.desc: Save customer cards securely for one-click checkout or recurring billing.
developers.cap.sandbox.title: Sandbox Mode
developers.cap.sandbox.desc: Full feature parity environment to test your integration with zero risk.
developers.cap.refunds.title: Instant Refunds
developers.cap.refunds.desc: Programmatically refund transactions to Mobile Wallets or Cards.
developers.cap.links.title: Payment Links
developers.cap.links.desc: Fallback to no-code links if building a full checkout UI is overkill.
developers.cap.logs.title: Audit Logs
developers.cap.logs.desc: Every API request is logged with full request/response payloads for debugging.
